Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Salt Lake City hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 17 of the 18 Salt Lake City hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Traveluro at 7, Vio.com at 4, trivago DEALS at 3, Agoda at 1, KAYAK.com at 1 and Super.com at 1. Taxes and fees at Salt Lake City hotels

At the 14 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 18% ($22 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 13% at Comfort Inn & Suites Woods Cross - Salt Lake City North to 18% at Comfort Inn Salt Lake City Downtown. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
